title: Air Freshener Spray - Lemon & Orange Blossom

details.description: Transform your home with the zesty aroma of lemon and orange blossoms. This premium Airwick aerosol spray eliminates unpleasant odours and fills your living spaces with a vibrant, rejuvenating fragrance. Its dual-action, water-based formula works quickly to clear malodours and refresh the air, making it ideal for instant freshening when guests arrive. Enjoy the uplifting scent and enhanced environment that this air freshener provides, perfect for daily use in your home.
details.usageInstructions:
Shake well before use.
Hold can upright and spray away from face and body. 
Note that the spray is released straight from front of the cap.

title: Freshmatic Automatic Spray Kit - Lavender & Lotus

details.description: Experience the perfect fusion of freshness and convenience with the Airwick Freshmatic Automatic Air Freshener Refill in Lemon and Orange Blossom. Infused with the zesty aroma of fresh-cut lemons and the delicate floral notes of orange blossom, this air freshener transforms your space into a vibrant, uplifting haven. Designed to automatically release bursts of continuous fragrance, the Airwick Freshmatic device ensures your home always smells beautifully clean and revitalised. With three intensity settings to choose from, you can easily adjust the frequency of the fragrance releases to suit your preferences. Enjoy up to 70 days of long-lasting, aromatic bliss, and create an environment that feels fresh, energising and inviting.
details.usageInstructions:
Read safety information carefully before use.
Retain instructions for future reference.To open, press down the button on the back of the device and pull. Ensure the control wheel on the back of the device is in the OFF position.
Insert 2 AA batteries. Ensure the positive (+) and negative (-) terminals are aligned correctly.
Before inserting the aerosol refill, ensure the red lever inside the device is pushed up. Then insert the aerosol refill with the spray nozzle facing out.
Close the device. Select the desired fragrance intensity using the control wheel located at the back (low, medium, high). When activated, the device will spray after a delay of 15 seconds.
If there is no spray after 15 seconds, switch off the device - a) Check that battery are inserted correctly, b) Remove aerosol refill and push up red lever. Directing the device away from your face, place the device where chosen. Ensure it is at least 2m from the floor level.

details.description: A unique fragrance that blends scents of Rose and Saffron, to fill your home with sweet and aromatic fragrances. One Airwick Freshmatic refill provides up to 70 days of fragrance (on ‘low’ setting on the device). For best results, use only Airwick Freshmatic Refills with the Airwick Freshmatic Device. The Airwick Freshmatic device automatically releases bursts of continuous fresh fragrance, so that your home always smells beautiful. There are three intensity settings available on the device - High, Medium & Low to regulate the frequency of sprays.

title: Essential Mist Diffuser Kit - Relaxing Lavender

details.description:
Airwick essential mist diffuser gives up to 45 days of continuous freshness for a delightful experience every time. The diffuser is battery operated and comes with 3 aa batteries to bring long-lasting fragrance into your bedroom, guestroom, gym, dining room etc. The stylish air wick device has 3 in-built fragrance intensity settings (low, medium, and high) to ensure just the right amount of fragrance as required. Just insert the battery and the refill and turn on the device using the slider at the bottom of the device. Voila! You’re all set to experience the ultimate fragrant home. Airwick diffuser transforms natural essential oils into a gentle fragrance mist with a relaxing lavender fragrance to elevate your home. Airwick essential mist diffuser is designed to run for 8 hours, releasing mist regularly and then go on standby for the next 16 hours. Once the refill gets over, replace it only with new air wick essential mist refills for the best experience.
Safety warning: use air wick essential mist diffuser as directed. Do not allow product spray to settle on surfaces or fabrics. Keep in a cool, dry place. Lifespan: 24 months

title: Essential Mist Diffuser Kit - Peony & Jasmine

details.description: Elevate your home's ambiance with the Airwick Essential Mist Automatic Fragrance Mist Diffuser Kit. This innovative device harnesses the power of natural essential oils to create a gentle, long-lasting fragrance mist that can transform any room. With its battery-operated design and easy-to-use slider, the Airwick Essential Mist Diffuser is perfect for bedrooms, guest rooms, gyms, dining rooms, and more. Customise the fragrance intensity to suit your preferences with three built-in settings - low, medium, and high. The included Relaxing Lavender refill, containing 20ml of essential oil, is designed to run for 8 hours, releasing mist regularly and then going on standby for the next 16 hours. When it's time to replace the refill, simply use a new Airwick Essential Mist refill for a seamless experience. Whether you're looking for a room freshener, bathroom freshener, or air freshener, the Airwick Essential Mist Automatic Fragrance Mist Diffuser Kit has got you covered, filling your space with a refreshing and calming ambiance for up to 45 days.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Twist to remove base of device.
2. Insert 3 AA batteries.
3. Remove refill cap (push down and twist anti-clockwise). Firmly push refill bottle upright until you hear it click in, and top of refill is secured in place.
4. Replace base of device.
5. Turn on device with slider (light will gently glow), select intensity setting.
6. Device will run for 8 hour cycle, releasing mist regularly, then go on standby for 16 hours.

details.description:
Give your bathroom a unique and fresh waft of lemons that helps soothe and give a feeling of relaxation throughout the day. Create a re-vitalising experience in your bathroom with Airwick EverFresh Gel. It has nature inspired fragrances locked in two distinct compartments for up to 30 days freshness. As the seasons change, so does the air. But Airwick offers you a rich palette of fragrances, so you can easily adapt the changes while you remain in your own comfortable fresh smelling home.
Discover the magic of Airwick EverFresh Gel. Pull one foil tab to activate the gel. Once the gel in this box finishes, pull out second tab. For strong fragrance – pull both tabs. It lasts for upto 30 days keeping your bathroom smelling fresh and fights away odours.
details.usageInstructions:
Step 1 - Hold the device with foil on the front
Step 2 - Pull one foil tab to activate it. When the gel in this box finishes, pull out second tab OR for strong fragrance - pull both tabs.
Step 3 - Place upright on the shelf or pull up the hook on the back to hang
